it.txt: Era vice-governadora e assumiu em 30/03/2026 depois que Ibaneis Rocha renunciou ao governo (ele anunciou que disputaria o Senado)
it.txt_en: She was vice governor. She became governor on March 30, 2026, after Ibaneis Rocha resigned (he had announced that he would run for the Senate).
